fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Checks whether the image specified in a process creation event is not a full, absolute path (caused by process ghosting or other unorthodox methods to start a process)
fields.name: Execution Of Non-Existing File
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((not tgt.process.image.path contains "\\") and (not (not (tgt.process.image.path matches "\.*") or (tgt.process.image.path in ("-","")) or ((tgt.process.image.path in ("System","Registry","MemCompression","vmmem")) or (tgt.process.cmdline in ("Registry","MemCompression","vmmem")))))))
